description: A one-statement handler continued by trailing `?` / `:`. Pre-round-4 impl#1 sent a ONE-statement value down the path that splits at newlines: `@r = @n⏎ + 1` became `set(r, n); + 1;` (the addend silently dropped), and the `?`/`:`/`*` forms failed E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC. Now any multi-line value lowers from its parsed statement list. All four positions: top (#top), engine state-child (#eng), `<match>` arm (#mat), `<each>` row (.row).
rationale: §5.2.3: "The statement list is logic context — the same statement grammar as a function body (§7.3) … The block MAY span any number of lines." and "No statement of the block SHALL be dropped".
